title: 了 — completed action
explanation: 了 after a verb marks the action as completed or realized. It is not a past-tense marker — it marks completion relative to the context. With a number + measure word, it means "already."
structure: Subj + Verb + 了 (+ Obj)  |  Subj + Verb + Num + MW + 了

examples.pinyin: wǒ chī le liǎng gè píngguǒ

notes: 句尾了 (sentence-final 了) marks a change of state: 我饿了 (I'm hungry now). Verb 了 + 句尾了 can combine: 我吃了两个苹果了 (I've eaten two apples already).
